result: At modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, ClientInfo is a type alias of InitializeRequestParams and ClientInfo::default() explicitly sets capabilities to ClientCapabilities::default(). ClientCapabilities derives Default; its sampling field is Option<SamplingCapability> and is skipped when None. Therefore, within this pinned source scope, the default client capability object has sampling=None and does not advertise sampling by default.
